description: This file is a PHP script for the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It generates reports listing test cases that have no requirements assigned in a specific test project. The script interacts with database tables to retrieve test case information, check coverage, and produce a view, likely in HTML, for users to see uncovered test cases.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves test project ID and name from session variables.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view test plan metrics.
